description: One video: what happens in it, its beats, its numbers and its formats. By post `url` or `video_id`: what happens, its hook, turn and beats; the moments worth copying with what to do; what it takes to shoot it again; views and length; its formats, the one every tool names for it first. not_in_corpus when Shorti has not read it. detail='full' adds every field.

lang.description: The creator's language. 'en' answers in the English Shorti wrote: never translate its Korean yourself.
